tools.name: get_record

tools.name: list_records

tools.name: get_account_history

tools.name: search_lexicons
tools.description: Browse or search the registry of published AT Protocol lexicon schemas. The response's `total` field is the exact registry size and `matched` is the exact match count. tools.name: resolve_lexicon
tools.description: Explain what a record type means by resolving its lexicon schema. Input is a collection NSID (e.g. app.bsky.feed.post). Returns the schema's description and definition.

tools.name: describe_pds
tools.description: Describe a Personal Data Server: its DID, whether registration requires an invite, the handle domains you can register there, and ToS/contact links. Works for any PDS, not just Bluesky. Input is the PDS origin (e.g. https://pds.example.com).

tools.name: list_repos
tools.description: List the accounts (repositories) hosted on a PDS, via com.atproto.sync.listRepos: each repo's DID and active/takedown status, paginated. tools.name: get_repo_status
tools.description: Liveness/moderation status of an account's repository: whether it is active, its current revision, and any takedown/suspended/deactivated/deleted state. Answers 'has @alice been taken down?' which get_profile can't. Input is a handle or DID.

tools.name: get_latest_commit
tools.description: The current head commit of an account's repository (com.atproto.sync.getLatestCommit): its commit CID and revision. tools.name: verify_handle
tools.description: Bidirectionally verify that a handle is really owned by its DID, via DNS TXT and HTTPS well-known. Returns whether each method passed. Use this to check for impersonation/spoofing,search results and resolve give candidates, this gives cryptographic binding.

tools.name: get_did_document
tools.description: Fetch the raw DID document for any DID or handle: all aliases (alsoKnownAs), every service entry (PDS, labeler, custom AppView), and verification methods. Broader than get_profile, and works for did:web accounts. Input is a handle or DID.

tools.name: get_app_link
tools.description: Turn an at:// URI (or handle/DID) into shareable web links,a Bluesky/Blacksky app URL to open in a browser, plus the canonical PDS getRecord URL. Use when the user wants a clickable/pasteable link.

tools.name: get_pds_directory_info
tools.description: A cached health card for a PDS from pds.directory: version, DID, approximate user count, reachability, last-checked time, available domains, and which relays index it. Input is the PDS hostname (e.g. pds.example.com). Best-effort/cached data.

tools.name: get_relay_directory_info
tools.description: A cached overview of a relay from firehose.directory: counts of PDSes it indexes (total/active/offline/banned) and total accounts. Input is the relay hostname (e.g. bsky.network). Best-effort/cached data.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_records, get_backlinks, get_app_link, list_repos_by_collection, list_blobs, get_blob_info, get_thread · Private data: resolve, get_record, list_records, get_backlinks, list_backlink_records, count_records, search_lexicons, resolve_lexicon, describe_pds, get_did_document, query_labels, list_blobs, get_blob_info, get_thread · Public sink: list_records, get_backlinks, resolve_lexicon, query_labels, list_repos_by_collection, count_repos_by_collection, get_thread.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_records, get_backlinks, get_app_link, list_repos_by_collection, list_blobs, get_blob_info, get_thread · Private data: resolve, get_record, list_records, get_backlinks, list_backlink_records, count_records, search_lexicons, resolve_lexicon, describe_pds, get_did_document, query_labels, list_blobs, get_blob_info, get_thread · Public sink: list_records, get_backlinks, resolve_lexicon, query_labels, list_repos_by_collection, count_repos_by_collection, get_thread

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
